show_holidays.description: Show public holidays alongside your own events.

events_per_day.description: How many events a day shows in the month grid before it collapses to a count. Three to five reads well; more turns the grid into a wall of text.

week_starts_monday.description: Start the week on Monday rather than Sunday.

dark_map.description: Use a dark basemap for event locations. It matches the panel, but the dark style hides shop and restaurant labels - the standard map draws them for you.

default_location.description: Where events happen unless you say otherwise. Set with the Choose on a map button above - this value is stored but not shown as a field.

keep_events_for_days.description: How long a finished one-off event is kept before being dropped at startup. Repeating events are never pruned. Set to 0 to keep everything.

enabled.description: Show a panel when an event is about to start.

lead_minutes.description: How far ahead of an event the reminder appears.

dismiss_seconds.description: How long the reminder stays before closing itself. It always closes on a tap.

snooze_minutes.description: How long Snooze puts a reminder off for.

refresh_minutes.description: How often subscribed calendars are re-fetched. Google's ICS feed is cached for hours, so polling faster does not make it fresher - it only costs requests. Minimum 15.
